_comment: REFERENCE workflow definition for Percy-Orchestrator (Logic Apps / Power Automate WDL). Matches the LIVE app schema (Shape A): the app writes the whole transcript to ConversationJson + Status='Pending'; this flow reads ConversationJson straight off the triggering item, runs the Percy agent, and writes AnswerText + Status='Answered'. NO Get-items/rebuild needed. SCAFFOLD: verify connector operationIds + connections on import (see README.md). The Copilot Studio agent call is a placeholder HTTP action — replace it.

Only_fresh_asks._comment: Loop guard: act only when the app's row is Pending with no answer yet. When this flow writes Status='Answered' the modify re-fires but fails this guard, so it stops.

Run_Percy_agent._comment: REPLACE with the Copilot Studio agent action. Input = ConversationJson (the full transcript) + UserEmail. The agent finds the latest user turn (Role='user', max Seq) inside the JSON and returns PLAIN TEXT.

Compose_AnswerText._comment: Sanitise: fall back if empty. Adjust the path to wherever the agent action returns its text.
Compose_AnswerText.inputs: @if(empty(trim(coalesce(body('Run_Percy_agent')?['text'], ''))), 'Sorry, I couldn''t answer that one — please try again.', body('Run_Percy_agent')?['text'])

On_error_write_friendly_answer._comment: Status MUST be 'Answered' so the app's poll displays the friendly message immediately. ErrorMessage is optional — only set it if the column exists.

parameters.item/AnswerText: Sorry, I couldn't reach the assistant just now — please try again.
